newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT FIRMS VS DOLLAR, BCE YEN, LIRA FUTURES DROP.
newsitem.headline: FORINT FIRMS VS DOLLAR, BCE YEN, LIRA FUTURES DROP.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed the Tuesday session of the interbank forex market firmer against the dollar as it followed movements on international markets, dealers said
The forint closed at 155.33/38 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155.44/49.
"The afternoon session was more animated, but overall, it was an average day," said Peter Benda of Citibank.
The forint remained close to the central bank bid, except for an insubstantial four fillers gap in early trade.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, Japanese yen and Italian lira futures were the main movers, dropping for four and three maturities respectively.
Total turnover rose slightly to 2.26 billion forints from Monday's 2.09 billion.
